name: url_reader
description: Fetches any public web page and returns clean, readable plain text stripped of HTML, navigation, scripts, advertisements, and boilerplate. Returns the page title, meta description, word count, and main body text ready for analysis or summarisation. Use this tool when an agent needs to read the content of a specific web page or article URL — for example to summarise an article, extract facts from a page, verify a claim by reading the source, or convert a web page into plain text to pass to another tool. Pass article URLs returned by news_headlines to this tool to read full article content. Do not use this tool to discover current news headlines — use news_headlines instead. Does not execute JavaScript — best suited for standard HTML content pages. Will not work with paywalled, login-protected, or JavaScript-rendered single-page applications.

url.description: The full public URL to fetch and read. Must include the scheme. Examples: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence', 'https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-12345678'. Only HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return from the page body text. Defaults to 8000. Set higher (up to 50000) for long articles or documents. Set lower for quick headline extraction. The response indicates whether content was truncated.

include_links.description: Whether to include a list of hyperlinks found on the page alongside the text content. Defaults to false. Set to true when the agent needs to discover further URLs to follow, such as when crawling a site or finding references.

url.description: The final URL after any redirects.

title.description: Page title from the HTML title tag or Open Graph metadata.

description.description: Page meta description or Open Graph description, if present.

content.description: Clean plain text body content of the page, up to max_chars characters.

word_count.description: Number of words in the full extracted content before any truncation.

char_count.description: Total character count of the full extracted content before any truncation.

truncated.description: True if the content was cut at the max_chars limit. Increase max_chars and retry to get more.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was fetched.

links.description: List of hyperlinks found on the page. Only present when include_links is true.
